meta.title: Work With Us
meta.description: Partner with GPODH — sponsored episodes, mini-series, webinars and event coverage reaching a specialist global digital health audience. Plus senior clinical and product consulting for clinical AI.

partnerships.eyebrow: If you want to go far, go together.
partnerships.title: Work with an audience that actually cares.
partnerships.intro: GPODH reaches a specialist global audience of clinicians, digital health founders, global health professionals, and investors. They are not passive listeners. They are practitioners who are actively building and funding the future of digital health in underserved settings.

primaryCta.note: Get in touch for a conversation about fit and pricing.

options.title: Sponsored Episodes
options.description: Align your organisation with a specific episode or series. Your message reaches an engaged, specialist audience in the right context.

options.title: Mini-Series
options.description: Commission a short series of episodes around a theme relevant to your work. Ideal for investors and donors who want to build thought leadership.

options.title: Video Conversations
options.description: Long-form recorded conversations for your own channels. Shubs brings his clinical and strategic lens to interview your team or partners.

options.title: Webinar Hosting
options.description: We host and moderate expert panels and webinars for organisations working in digital health. Structured, substantive, globally minded.

options.title: Event Coverage
options.description: On the ground at conferences and summits, capturing conversations and producing content that extends the life of the event.

options.title: Propose a Session or Speaker
options.description: Want us to explore a great story or talk to an incredible individual? Know someone doing fascinating work in digital health? Let us know. We're always looking for the next compelling conversation.

partnerships.closingBody: To discuss a partnership, use the contact form and tell us what you have in mind.

photos.alt: Shubs hosting a panel at IBIS Capital

consulting.title: From promising to proven.
consulting.body: Shubs provides senior clinical and product counsel for clinical AI, for teams where both speed and evidence matter. That's the difference between a product that's promising and one that's proven.
consulting.trustNote: Trusted by clinical, tech, and product leaders.
